preview.text: Hong Kong, China and Singapore are playing a T20 match at Bayuemas Oval, where the usual first-innings score in the 89 recorded T20 matches is 119. Hong Kong, China won the toss and chose to bat first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 93 per cent chance of rain and about 32 degrees.

summary.text: Hong Kong, China won by 38 runs. HKC made 172-5, Anshuman Rath top-scoring with 95 off 56 balls; Manpreet Singh (c) took 3 for 22. SIN made 129-6, Manpreet Singh (c) top-scoring with 65 off 38 balls; Yasim Murtaza (c) took 2 for 12. Sides batting first at Bayuemas Oval usually make about 119.
